nodes.label: Local Playwright e2e Runbook
nodes.rationale: playwright.config.ts has no webServer block on purpose (#342) — a config that built and served the app produced runs reporting green while testing a broken server.

nodes.label: Staging .next/static into the Standalone Output
nodes.rationale: Standalone copies public/ but not .next/static: the server answers /api/health and HTML with 200 while every chunk 404s, so specs fail one by one as if the product were broken. BSD cp -R into an existing dst nests static/static.

nodes.label: e2e global-setup Preflight
nodes.rationale: Inspects whatever is on PLAYWRIGHT_BASE before a single spec runs and aborts with the fix — REDIS_URL set, no server, db down, no own JavaScript, wrong build, missing AUTH_SECRET.

edges.source_location: Wrapper summaries lie — PASS(0) FAIL(0) after a global-setup abort
'renders HTML but does not serve its own JavaScript' rejection
preflight exists so a green run cannot be a run against a broken server
